title: Planner: save AI-generated filters in Planner Agent chat
summary: The briefing matches the roadmap and accurately describes the documented Planner Agent access controls. It distinguishes those existing controls and licensing requirements from the still-undocumented defaults, licensing and data handling of saved filters.

claims.claim: No admin UI is documented for the in-Planner Planner Agent access setting.
claims.quote: Searched: "Planner Agent" "admin center" "AllowPlannerCopilot". Opened turn-off-planner-agent; it documents PowerShell, not a UI. Search results for managing agents or the Planner Plugin in Copilot concern different experiences.

claims.claim: Set-PlannerConfiguration supports AllowPlannerCopilot and PlannerCopilotAllowedGroupId, and Get-PlannerConfiguration verifies these settings.
claims.quote: Set-PlannerConfiguration -AllowPlannerCopilot $false; Set-PlannerConfiguration -AllowPlannerCopilot $true; Set-PlannerConfiguration -AllowPlannerCopilot $true -PlannerCopilotAllowedGroupId <security group id>; To verify your settings, run the following command: Get-PlannerConfiguration

claims.where: controls[0].governs and scope; Why it matters; Risk assessment; Governance controls
claims.claim: The tenant Planner Agent access setting governs Planner Agent and its in-Planner chat as a whole, the experience in which the roadmap places saved filters.
claims.quote: As an admin, you can control access to these features for your organization or restrict them to specific security groups. To turn off Planner Agent and Planner Agent chat for all users: Set-PlannerConfiguration -AllowPlannerCopilot $false

claims.where: controls[1]; summary; Governance controls; Open questions
claims.claim: No separate UI or API control is documented for whether users can save AI-generated filters.
claims.quote: Searched: "Planner Agent" "saved filters" "control"; "Planner Agent" "save" "filters" "PowerShell" "admin". Opened turn-off-planner-agent and Copilot release notes; no saved-filter-specific switch, path or command found.

claims.where: controls[0].note; Governance guidance: At rollout; Governance controls
claims.claim: Changes to the Planner Agent access policy may take up to an hour.
claims.quote: The policy changes may require up to an hour to become effective.

claims.claim: Turning off Planner Agent also disables Facilitator's document authoring skill.
claims.quote: Turning off Planner Agent will also disable document authoring skill of Facilitator. All other Facilitator skills remain unaffected.

claims.where: Governance guidance: Before rollout and After rollout
claims.claim: Get-PlannerConfiguration reports AllowPlannerCopilot as True or False.
claims.quote: The value for -AllowPlannerCopilot returned by the Get-PlannerConfiguration command shows whether these features are turned on for your organization, such as: AllowPlannerCopilot: True or False

claims.claim: Get-PlannerConfiguration reports PlannerCopilotAllowedGroupId for the access configuration.
claims.quote: PlannerCopilotAllowedGroupId: Displays the Security Group ID when these features are turned on for your organization

claims.claim: An invalid security group ID leaves all users without access even when AllowPlannerCopilot is true.
claims.quote: If the Security Group ID is invalid, no users will have access, even if AllowPlannerCopilot is set to $true.

claims.claim: Set-PlannerConfiguration can restrict Planner Agent and its chat to a pilot security group.
claims.quote: To turn on Planner Agent and Planner Agent chat for a specific security group: Set-PlannerConfiguration -AllowPlannerCopilot $true -PlannerCopilotAllowedGroupId <security group id>
